doge.headline: Two decimals, very different seasons
doge.body: Ordway and Son leads DOGE 4 at 5–1 after edging El Niño Grande 137.80–136.82. Corey had the second-highest score of the week and still fell to 2–4. Cody’s 91.70–91.52 win over Bryan required even less separation; he joins Andrew, Bennett and Pete at 4–2. Andrew beat his brother, Sandy returned to even, and Patrick earned his second win. Week 6 is final. The completed matchups stay in view; these are not Week 7 projections.

loog.headline: The first win, and the very large one
loog.body: All Ugly finally won, edging CeeDeep 134.1–132.65 for Cody and Ferret's first victory. Roy supplied the week's highest score, 175.48, while Kush's win over Skatt kept Mr Hopkins Opus first at five and one. Route 22 and Kraft returned to even. Norm beat Sherm despite Pollard Greens retaining the league's highest cumulative scoring total.

sunday-crew.headline: Nipun alone at five and one; Joe changes the front of the race
sunday-crew.body: Joe’s J Bird posted Sunday Crew’s highest Week 6 score, 151.74, to beat Runit and reach three and three after three straight wins. Nipun moved to five and one, the league’s only one-loss record. Paul beat Ravi to join Runit and Greg at four and two. Andrew and Sandy now share three-and-three records; Cody and Drew each collected a second win. Drew’s 1.48-point escape against Greg was the closest finish, one of two games decided by fewer than four.
